map.由欠款余额与日利率求月利息: Monthly Interest from Outstanding Balance and Daily Rate
map.输入欠款余额、日利率、计息天数，求利息。: Enter the outstanding balance, daily rate and days accrued to find the interest.
map.📖 查看「由欠款余额与日利率求月利息 使用指南」: View "Monthly Interest from Outstanding Balance and Daily Rate User Guide"
map.I = 余额×日利率×天数。 1000 元,0.05%/天,30 天 → 15: I = balance × daily rate × days. 1000 yuan, 0.05%/day, 30 days → 15 yuan.
map.月利息=欠款余额×日利率×计息天数。多数银行未全额还款即从每笔消费记账日起按日计: Monthly interest = balance × daily rate × days accrued. Most banks, if not paid in full, charge daily interest from each transaction's posting date and the grace period is lost; annualized this is about daily rate × 365 (e.g. 0.05%×365≈18.25%).
map.未全额还款时估算当月循环利息成本。: Estimate the monthly revolving interest cost when not paid in full.
map.对比「最低还款」与「全额还款」的利息差异。: Compare the interest difference between minimum and full payment.
map.提醒持卡人免息期内还清可避免计息。: Remind cardholders that paying within the grace period avoids interest.
map.月利息=余额×日利率×天数=5,000×0.0005×30=75 元。折合月化约: Monthly interest = balance × daily rate × days = 5,000×0.0005×30 = 75 yuan. About 0.05%×30=1.5% monthly, ≈18% annualized.
map.为什么只还最低还款额利息很高？: Why is interest so high if only the minimum is paid?
map.未还部分从每笔消费记账日起按日利率计息（多数银行不再享受免息期），且下月对剩余本: The unpaid part accrues daily interest from each transaction's posting date (most banks drop the grace period), and the remaining principal keeps compounding next month, so long-run cost far exceeds installments.
map.免息期内还款要利息吗？: Is interest charged if paid within the grace period?
map.在账单日到还款日之间的免息期内全额还清，通常不产生循环利息。一旦选择最低还款或逾: Paying the full amount within the grace period between statement and due date usually incurs no revolving interest. Once you choose minimum payment or default, the grace treatment is lost.
